meta.dd_quantile_convention: q = quantile of drawdown depth, reported as a negative number
meta.k_star_rule: largest k on the 0.50..2.00 grid (cash <= 1.00) with full-window 5-offset blend max DD >= -30%, the account constraint, and at least one sleeve left after the minimum-capital drop; if no k meets all three, the largest k meeting the last two and dd_budget_unmet = true
meta.weights_note: weights_last = mean over the five offsets of target weights at the last rebalance <= 2026-09-15

identity.I3: n/a (T-32 cache holds only the 5-offset S3 blend, no offset-0 series)

small.reason: no D1 passer and no admissible CAP2 level

1M.reason: no D1 passer and no admissible CAP2 level

small.basis: unlevered 5-offset blend, recent window, excess over BIL

1M.basis: unlevered 5-offset blend, recent window, excess over BIL
